name: 76135 · Fort Worth, TX
findings: ZIP 76135 (Fort Worth) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76135 (Fort Worth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76135 (Fort Worth) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
